decisionsTitle: «Confirmă pentru tombolă»: the Organizer or an Administrator confirms a volunteer who is not confirmed for the raffle alone — a minor only with the parent's or guardian's agreement, and how (amending §984 and §1023); «Scanează» on an iPhone; the file for random.org with the names (amending §67 and §1023)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20, the day before Saturday's race, with two pictures:** on «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» a volunteer's row read «Voluntar · Nu · neconfirmat · Nu · Scoate»; on «Voluntari» the same person — seventeen — read «Înscris», «Acordul părintelui lipsește», «Link trimis părintelui»: «vreau să pot să o confirm și pe [ea] pentru tombolă, chiar și fără acordul părinților». The club's approved «Regulamentul tombolei» says «Un participant minor se înscrie cu acordul părintelui sau al tutorelui său.» (`templates/raffle-rules.ts`), so the owner was asked, and chose: an Organizer or an Administrator confirms such a volunteer **for the raffle**, recording that the parent or guardian agreed and how — by telephone, in person, in writing —; the volunteering agreement stays missing and the person stays unconfirmed as a volunteer.

**What was there.** §984's one answer took a volunteer only «Confirmat» and with a number; §1023 drew the V number at «Confirmă»; and «Confirmă» on a minor waits for the parent's acceptance of the volunteering agreement (§768, `guardianAllowsConfirm`). A minor whose parent had not signed — the link sent, the race the next morning — could take no part in the raffle, although the rules ask only the parent's agreement to the raffle.

**Decision.**

- **«Confirmă pentru tombolă»** — a press of the Organizer and the Administrators alone, by the predicate that already keeps the organizers' presses of the raffle (`canTakeRaffleList`: `canReadRegistrations` and `canManageVolunteers`), asserted at the action's door (`checkin/tombola/actions.ts#raffleConfirmVolunteerAction`) and again in the service (`volunteers/raffle-confirmation.ts#confirmVolunteerForRaffle`); the desk's Voluntar, the Redactor and Tehnic are drawn no button and refused `FORBIDDEN` (BR-REQ-060-01). Offered on the person's row of «Tombolă» — where it read «Nu · neconfirmat» — and on the volunteer's own page, for a volunteer of the event who is «Înscris» (not confirmed, not cancelled), not confirmed for the raffle already and not taken out («Pune înapoi» first), at an event whose raffle takes its volunteers, and «Cu înscriere separată» only while the sign-up's gate takes volunteers (`domain/raffle.ts#raffleConfirmationOffered`): a page never offers a press the server refuses. Asked first by the house's dialog, which names the person — «Confirmi pe {name} pentru tombolă?», what the press does, «Nu pleacă niciun email către {name}.», «Anulează» focused, «Da, confirmă pentru tombolă».
- **A minor** — under eighteen on the event's day, the age «Acordul părintelui lipsește» is decided by (`isVolunteerMinor`) — is confirmed only with the way the parent or guardian agreed chosen on the row (a native select, «Cum și-a dat acordul părintele»: «telefonic», «la fața locului», «în scris»; the dialog's sentence names it, «… dat telefonic») and the dialog's box «Părintele sau tutorele a fost de acord să participe la tombolă» ticked, which its confirm waits for (`ConfirmSpec.tick`, §888's mechanism). The service refuses without either, naming what is missing (`RAFFLE_GUARDIAN_MISSING`, `raffleGuardianRecord`; a forged truthy string is no tick, a way outside the three is no way); without JavaScript there is no dialog, and a minor's empty answers are refused by name. An adult: no box, the same press, and nothing of a parent recorded whatever a form posts.
- **One transaction under the event row's lock**, the V numbers' serialization point (§1023): the person's V number drawn when they have none — `volunteer-numbers.ts#drawVolunteerNumber`, the very draw «Confirmă» makes, the next one the event never gave; a later «Confirmă» keeps it, since it draws only for a row without one, and a number is never reissued —; the row marked by four nullable columns on `event_volunteers` — `raffle_confirmed_at`, `raffle_confirmed_by_staff_user_id` (`ON DELETE SET NULL`) and, for a minor, `raffle_guardian_agreed` with `raffle_guardian_way` (`PHONE`, `IN_PERSON`, `WRITING`) — under two CHECKs: nothing of a confirmation without its moment, and the parent's agreement as its tick and one of the three ways together, or neither (written with `IS TRUE` and `IS NOT NULL`, since a CHECK passes on NULL); migration `0227_volunteer_raffle_confirmation`, generated by drizzle-kit after `0226_staff_team_agreement_every_sign_in`, expand only, nothing backfilled. «Cu înscriere separată» the person is signed up in the same transaction by the organizers' own door (STAFF, `raffle-entries.ts#signUpConfirmedVolunteerInTransaction`: the checks, the row and the audit row of «Înscrie»), the row's «A acceptat regulamentul» required and the gate asked again — shut, nothing at all is written. One audit row of its own, `volunteer.raffle_confirmed`: the staff member its actor, and of the person their id, whether a minor, the way, the V number and whether the press drew it, and the sign-up it wrote (`raffleEntryId`) — never a name. A second press changes nothing and writes nothing.
- **It is not the volunteer's state.** The person stays «Înscris»; their volunteering agreement, the parent's acceptance of it and the parent's link are exactly as they were; «Confirmă» as a volunteer still waits for the parent's volunteering agreement (§768). Nobody is emailed and no public cache is expired.
- **Who takes part** (amending §984 and §1023): a volunteer takes part when confirmed, as before, **or confirmed for the raffle**, and holding a V number — `raffleConfirmed` at `raffleParticipation`'s second step and in `raffle-roster.ts#raffleEligible`, from `volunteerConfirmedForRaffle`: never a cancelled volunteer, and a minor's only with the parent's agreement recorded (a date of birth corrected since to a minor's offers the press again, with the box). Every reader reads it: «Tombolă» and its counts, «Lista pentru tombolă» and «— doar prezenții», «Descarcă pentru random.org» and its present-only twin, the lists' «Tombolă» column (`raffleReasonsFor`), the volunteer's line, the public form's «Sunt voluntar» (`matchRafflePerson`) and «Toate datele unei persoane» (art. 15). «Scoate» still takes the person out; a cancelled volunteer takes part in nothing, the record kept on the row.
- **Words**, in both catalogues, every line within 200 characters: the button and its accessible name, the dialog and its box, the way's select and the three ways, «Da · confirmat doar pentru tombolă» (with «acordul părintelui: telefonic» for a minor) on the tab's row for every desk role — a raffle's confirmation, never a volunteer's —, «Confirmat doar pentru tombolă, nu ca voluntar» on the volunteer's page, «Da · confirmat doar pentru tombolă» in the «Voluntari» list's column, the refusal, three toasts, the tab's intro and «Jurnal»'s kind, verb, count and «· acordul părintelui: …». The guide's «Tombola în ziua cursei» gains four steps; «Tombola: cine participă și cum» and the desk's «La tombolă: cine participă, și înscrie pe cineva» say the same. `AGENTS.md` §10.2 and §15.11, `BUSINESS.md` BR-BUS-060 and its raffle paragraph, `SETUP.md` §47, `docs/RUNBOOKS.md` § The raffle on race day and `docs/WHERE-THINGS-LIVE.md` too.
- **«Jurnal»** (§996, beside §1020's take-out): the kind «Confirmați pentru tombolă» — «Org1 a confirmat pentru tombolă Maria Pop (voluntar) · acordul părintelui: telefonic» —, filtered by «Ce s-a făcut» and counted per account in «Pe conturi»; read by the volunteers' own read beside the «Prezent» ticks, still six queries whatever the rows.

**Legal texts.** None is edited. The approved rules already say a minor takes part with the parent's or guardian's agreement; the press records it. The privacy notice's template names neither this confirmation nor the record of how a parent agreed — its raffle paragraph names a sign-up and who recorded it, its volunteers' paragraph the volunteering agreement —, so `docs/OWNER-TODO.md` item 27 asks the club's lawyer whether section 5 should say it, at the next approval.

**Refused.** Confirming a minor as a volunteer without the parent's volunteering agreement: the owner asked for the raffle, and §768 stands. Any change to the parent's link or its email. The parent's agreement as a typed line: three ways answer «cum», and a typed line would keep words nobody asked to keep. The press for every desk role: the raffle's decisions are the organizers' (§1014). A trail row that names the person: the trail says who decided and how, never whom. Another series for these numbers: the V number is the volunteer's, whichever confirmation comes first.

**Not done.** Undoing the confirmation: «Scoate» takes the person out and a cancel ends it, and nothing deletes the record. A volunteer cancelled and reopened takes part again on the earlier confirmation. The staff account that pressed it is not listed in «Toate datele unei persoane»: it is the club's own record, as a note's author is (§777).

**Tests.** `tests/unit/volunteers/raffle-confirmation-rules.test.ts`, `tests/integration/volunteers/raffle-confirmation.test.ts`, `tests/integration/volunteers/raffle-confirmation-screens.test.ts`, `tests/integration/db/volunteer-raffle-confirmation-migration.test.ts`, `tests/concurrency/volunteer-numbers.test.ts`, e2e `tests/e2e/raffle-confirm-volunteer.spec.ts`; the guards `raffle-never-leaves.test.ts` and `raffle-entries-never-leave.test.ts` list the new reader, and `confirmed-actions.test.ts` the new press.

**Also in this release, the same evening.**

- **«Scanează» on an iPhone** (amending §67, which left iOS Safari to the camera app «with zero bytes»). The owner, 2026-11-20, with a volunteer's picture of «Masa de ridicare a numerelor» on an iPhone: «Elizei nu îi apare butonul scanează». Safari has no `BarcodeDetector`, so the button was not drawn. Asked, the owner chose a reader: `QrScanButton` now draws «Scanează» wherever the browser can open a camera (`navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`), reads with the browser's own `BarcodeDetector` where it exists (Android Chrome, unchanged) and else with **jsQR 1.4.0** (`jsqr`, pinned exactly, pure JavaScript, no WebAssembly, no request to anybody), loaded by a dynamic import only on that press — a frame drawn on a canvas, its long side at most 800 pixels, read without the inverted pass. Nothing else of the dialog changes: the camera's choice, its memory, the focus, the code's check and the address it opens. The camera app stays the way where no camera can be opened, and the guide says so («Dacă butonul lipsește»). Refused: a WebAssembly polyfill (a file fetched from a CDN by default, and more bytes) and a library on every phone (Android keeps its own reader).
- **«Descarcă pentru random.org» with the names** (amending §1023, which wrote numbers alone «a name would leave the site for a third party the privacy notice does not name»). The owner, 2026-11-20: «cand descarc pentru random.org trebuie sa am BIB (sau nr voluntar) dar si nume». Asked — names only for those who ticked to appear, names for everybody, or numbers alone — the owner chose **names for everybody**: each line is the number as the raffle writes it, a space and the name, its spaces folded to one (`raffle-list.ts#buildRaffleRandomOrgText`); the same people, order, CRLF and file names as before, and a participant with no number still left out. The words of the buttons, the «?» and the guide say «un rând pe persoană, număr și nume». random.org now receives the names: `docs/OWNER-TODO.md` item 28 asks the club's lawyer for the privacy notice's sentence, and until then the random.org screen stays off the livestream.
- **The guide's lines within 200 characters** in both catalogues (five of «Confirmă pentru tombolă»'s ran past it).

Migration `0227_volunteer_raffle_confirmation` (the number may move at landing). One new dependency: `jsqr` 1.4.0, exact.
changelogLine: - **«Confirmă pentru tombolă»** — on «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» and on a volunteer's page, the Organizer or an Administrator confirms a volunteer who is not confirmed for the raffle alone: they get their V number and take part, still unconfirmed as a volunteer; a minor only with the parent's or guardian's agreement ticked and how it was given (by phone, in person, in writing), kept with who decided in «Jurnal». **«Scanează» works on an iPhone too** (a QR reader in JavaScript where the browser has none), and **«Descarcă pentru random.org» writes each number with its name**. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 21 and 25. Given an event's raffle, then a volunteer the organizers confirmed for the raffle alone («Confirmă pentru tombolă») — not cancelled and, under eighteen on the event's day, only with the parent's or guardian's agreement recorded — takes part as a confirmed volunteer does, with their V number: «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» and its counts, «Lista pentru tombolă» and its present-only twin, both files for random.org, the lists' «Tombolă» column and the public raffle form's «Sunt voluntar» all hold them, the tab's row saying «Da · confirmat doar pentru tombolă» (and for a minor «acordul părintelui: telefonic», «la fața locului» or «în scris»); «Scoate» takes them out, and a cancelled volunteer is in none (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/raffle-confirmation-rules.test.ts`; integration `volunteers/raffle-confirmation.test.ts`, `volunteers/raffle-confirmation-screens.test.ts`; e2e `raffle-confirm-volunteer.spec.ts`.

Given a volunteer of an event that holds a raffle who is «Înscris», when the Organizer or an Administrator presses «Confirmă pentru tombolă» — on the person's row of «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» or on their own page, asked first by the dialog that names them —, then in one transaction under the event row's lock the volunteer gets the event's next V number when they have none (never a second, kept by a later «Confirmă»), `event_volunteers.raffle_confirmed_at` and `raffle_confirmed_by_staff_user_id` are set, and one `volunteer.raffle_confirmed` audit row names the staff member, whether a minor, the parent's way and the number, never the name; a volunteer under eighteen on the event's day is confirmed only with the box «Părintele sau tutorele a fost de acord să participe la tombolă» ticked and the way chosen — «telefonic», «la fața locului», «în scris» —, else `RAFFLE_GUARDIAN_MISSING` names what is missing and nothing is written; «Cu înscriere separată» the person is signed up by the organizers' STAFF door in the same transaction, «A acceptat regulamentul» required; the volunteer's state, volunteering agreement and parent's link do not change, nobody is emailed, and «Ziua cursei» → «Jurnal» says who decided, when and how the parent agreed (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/raffle-confirmation.test.ts`, `volunteers/raffle-confirmation-screens.test.ts`, `race-day/journal.test.ts`; concurrency `volunteer-numbers.test.ts`; e2e `raffle-confirm-volunteer.spec.ts`.

Given migration `0227_volunteer_raffle_confirmation`, then `event_volunteers` gains four nullable columns — `raffle_confirmed_at`, `raffle_confirmed_by_staff_user_id` (`ON DELETE SET NULL`), `raffle_guardian_agreed`, `raffle_guardian_way` — and two CHECKs refusing anything of a confirmation without its moment and a parent's agreement other than its tick with one of `PHONE`, `IN_PERSON`, `WRITING`, or neither; every volunteer from before reads not confirmed for the raffle, and the file only expands (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `db/volunteer-raffle-confirmation-migration.test.ts`; unit `db/migration-chain.test.ts`.

Given «Confirmă pentru tombolă», then it is authorized by `canTakeRaffleList` — the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator — at the action's door and again in the service: the desk's Voluntar, the Redactor, Tehnic and a member are refused `FORBIDDEN` with nothing written, and «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» draws the button for none of them, though every desk role reads the same rows (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/raffle-confirmation.test.ts`, `volunteers/raffle-confirmation-screens.test.ts`; e2e `raffle-confirm-volunteer.spec.ts`.

batchLine: «Confirmă pentru tombolă» for a volunteer (a minor with the parent's agreement), «Scanează» on iPhone, names in the random.org file
